description: Section 9.5: the owner's own reply quoting the whole of a long message gets a card whose excerpt is the first 140 characters of unquote(quoted).

divergences.note: The fourth bullet of section 9.5 says "the first 140 characters of unquote(quoted)"; es-core cuts that text as in section 9.3 instead (139 characters, back to a word boundary, then "…"). The vector holds the first 140 characters.
